name: SitePause
author: Marta Fernandez

sections.description:
SitePause lets you enable maintenance mode on a specific page without putting your entire WordPress site offline.

Unlike traditional maintenance plugins, SitePause gives you full control to work on individual pages while keeping the rest of your website live.

Perfect for:
– Updating a landing page
– Editing sales pages without downtime
– Performing SEO-safe maintenance
– Working on content without affecting visitors

Key features:
– Enable maintenance mode per page
– Does not affect the rest of the site
– Returns proper 503 HTTP status code
– Supports Retry-After header for SEO compliance
– Lightweight and easy to use
